questions.prompt: Why do we have day and night?
options: The Earth spins on its axis
The Sun goes round the Earth
questions.explain: Each place turns towards and away from the Sun.

questions.prompt: In which direction does the Sun rise?
questions.explain: Because the Earth spins west to east.

questions.prompt: How long does the Earth take to spin once?
Which part of India sees the sunrise first?
questions.explain: The east turns to face the Sun first.

questions.prompt: When it is day in India, it is night in…
options: the USA, on the other side of the Earth
questions.explain: The far side faces away from the Sun.

questions.prompt: At what time of day is your shadow shortest?
questions.explain: The Sun is highest in the sky.

options: An imaginary line through the North and South Poles

questions.prompt: Your little cousin thinks the Sun moves across the sky. How would you explain what really happens?
questions.modelAnswer: The Sun stays in its place. The Earth spins round once every 24 hours. As our part of the Earth turns towards the Sun, we see it rise in the east; as we turn away, it seems to set in the west, and it becomes night.
rubric: Sun does not move across the sky
